answer: The tide cap is enforced at intake and voyage shows the per-origin counts. At most 3 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a meadow tag. A datacenter or proxy pool therefore cannot mint a swarm in one epoch no matter how much capital it holds, because each member consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. That is 17 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
